name: oss-autopilot
description: AI-powered autopilot for managing open source contributions
author: John Costa

_pnpmOverridesRationale._note: Rationale for each entry in pnpm.overrides. Inert JSON — pnpm ignores unknown top-level keys. Revisit periodically with `pnpm why <pkg>` to confirm the override is still hit by the dep graph (#963).
_pnpmOverridesRationale.hono: Transitive via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. Pin >=4.12.7 to avoid the pre-4.12.7 security advisory family. Confirmed still in tree.
_pnpmOverridesRationale.@hono/node-server: Transitive via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. Pin >=1.19.10 alongside hono. Confirmed still in tree.
_pnpmOverridesRationale.express-rate-limit: Transitive via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. Pin >=8.2.2 for known advisory. Confirmed still in tree.
_pnpmOverridesRationale.flatted: Dev-only, transitive via eslint -> flat-cache. Pin >=3.4.2 for ReDoS advisory. Confirmed still in tree.
_pnpmOverridesRationale.picomatch: Dev-only, transitive via typescript-eslint -> tinyglobby. Pin >=4.0.4 for ReDoS advisory. Confirmed still in tree.
_pnpmOverridesRationale.path-to-regexp: Transitive via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> express/router. Pin >=8.4.0 for ReDoS advisory. Confirmed still in tree.
_pnpmOverridesRationale.yaml: Dev-only, transitive via vitest -> vite. Pin >=2.8.3 for code-execution advisory. Confirmed still in tree.
